summary.en-US: Capture and share your personal YouTube Home recommendations with a temporary link.

description.en-US: Open YouTube Home, click Upload Snapshot, and the extension captures loaded video and Shorts cards. It uploads parsed metadata to myfyp.link and returns a temporary share link.

developer_comments.en-US: The extension runs only on YouTube Home and uploads data only after explicit user action. The popup shows link history with share and delete links. Users can delete a snapshot immediately, and snapshots expire automatically after 7 days.

release_notes.en-US: Stability and UX improvements for snapshot sharing.

version.approval_notes: The extension runs only on YouTube Home and requires explicit user action to upload a snapshot to myfyp.link.
